units.L: Measured rest-height units; local Hand_L target delta from that rig's neutral hand anchor.
units.front: Measured rest-height units; front sole target offset from that rig's measured sole anchor.
units.back: Measured rest-height units; back sole target offset from that rig's measured sole anchor.

composition: Every fighter has its own manually specified hold base and individually specified regional/hand/support changes for each named pose. Poses below are fully expanded; there is no shared roster keyframe or random/procedural motion score.

ember-vale.intent: Furnace-jaw clinch: committed forward intent, rear-foot ignition load and an angry interruption. Victim motion breaks the combustion rhythm before a driven recovery.

rook-ironside.intent: Fortress clamp: broad hips and locked shoulders carry the hold. Resistance remains one heavy unit; escape buys a braced weight transfer rather than agility.

juno-spark.intent: Circuit catch: compact alternating diagonals and a narrow loaded foot, with a sharp routing reversal. Victim current desynchronizes in a small recoil, then escape snaps into a new compact line.

kaia-windrow.intent: Pressure cradle: an open crescent held by banked hips and a counterbalancing hand. Restraint disturbs balance, resistance restores an arc, escape redirects sideways and landing bleeds force through a spiral step.

nix-calder.intent: Cryolattice lock: vertical facets, measured hands and exact stop points. Resistance flexes then fractures structure; escape restores a chosen brace rather than a flourish.

orion-vell.intent: Orbital suspension: composed center, small hand-vector changes and counter-rotating regional curves. Restraint scatters orbital order; escape re-centers the mass before the hands settle.

vesper-nyx.intent: Offset phase catch: asymmetric shoulder lead and a withheld opposite hand. Restraint forces one coherent body, resistance tests a different diagonal, escape slips into a clearly chosen physical position.

yin.intent: Subtractive stillness: inward elbows and economical palms shorten the hold's shape without hiding the white seed. Restraint swallows force; resistance exposes a small discontinuity, escape folds inward before settling.

yang.intent: Declared construction: symmetric hands, exact regional alignment and a small opposing black seed. Restraint cracks ordered geometry; escape reforms outward braces before an exact return.
